newsitem.title: UK: FTSE 100 hits new high as U.S. figures boost bonds.
newsitem.headline: FTSE 100 hits new high as U.S. figures boost bonds.

text.p: Britain's FTSE 100 stock index hit a trading record on Friday, tracking a surge in U.S. Treasury bonds after lower-than-expected U.S. inflation and retail sales figures.
The FTSE was up 14.3 points at 3,946.9 by 1240 GMT, surpassing the previous intraday high of 3,944.8 set earlier in the day.
U.S. consumer prices rose a lower-than-expected 0.1 percent in August, while retail sales were up 0.2 percent, also below forecasts.
The 30-year U.S. T-bond was up more than one point on the news, setting the scene for a strong Dow opening.
